custom_schema_cases.text:
JOB POSTING — Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Company: Quantum Leap AI
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Type: Full-time, Hybrid

We are seeking a Senior ML Engineer to join our Applied Research team. You will design and deploy large-scale recommendation and ranking systems serving 40M+ daily active users.

Salary: EUR 95,000 – EUR 130,000 depending on experience, plus equity

Requirements:
- 5+ years in ML engineering
- Strong background in PyTorch or JAX
- Experience with distributed training at scale
- Familiarity with MLOps (Kubeflow, MLflow)

Apply by: September 30, 2025
Send CV and portfolio to: careers@quantumleap-ai.com

custom_schema_cases.text:
PATIENT REFERRAL LETTER
Date: November 4, 2024

Dear Specialist,

I am referring my patient, Mr. Tobias Kleinhempel (DOB: 1969-03-22), for a cardiology consultation. Over the past three months, Mr. Kleinhempel has reported recurring episodes of chest tightness and exertional dyspnoea. A recent ECG showed non-specific ST changes and his NT-proBNP is mildly elevated at 320 pg/mL.

I am requesting an echocardiogram and a full cardiology assessment to rule out ischaemic heart disease or early heart failure.

Urgency: Urgent — please schedule within two weeks if possible.

Referring Physician: Dr. Amara Osei, MBBS, MRCGP
GP Practice: Greenfield Medical Centre, Edinburgh
